title: EpisodeNote
description: Note-serialized situation model for the Episode Artifact (ADR-0051 OD-1/OD-2). Vault-canonical -- the note is the source of record; any PG projection is a rebuildable query index only, never authoritative. Indexed on the five situation-model dimensions (time, space, causation, goal, protagonist) per ADR-0051 Decision §1. `episode_id` is a fused id (`ep-<uuid>`), a disjoint identifier space from Heimdal's per-capture-session `episode_id` (FABLE_COMPANION §1.3) -- a raw Heimdal session id may appear in `derived_from` but never as this note's own `episode_id` (app/episodes/ids.py enforces this at the write seam). `segmentation: proposed` is a low-trust opt-out proposal (ADR-0051 §5) -- it carries no DecisionToken/AuthorityReceipt; canonical standing arrives via silent acceptance or human re-cut (ERE-07), not a governed transition.

episode_id.description: Fused episode id, ep-<uuid>. Disjoint from Heimdal's per-session episode_id space (ADR-0051; ERE-02 AC4).

scope.description: Scope this episode is bound to.

time.description: Minimal temporal commitment per ADR-0051 §3 item 6: start / end / closed. Closure is the load-bearing property.

closed.description: Whether the episode's boundary is closed. Closure drives event-triggered relevance decay (Event Horizon Model).

space.description: Space/place dimension of the situation model.

protagonists.description: Protagonist dimension of the situation model.

goal.description: Goal dimension; binds the episode upward to projects/areas.

causation.description: Causation dimension of the situation model.

parent_episode.description: Fused episode_id of the nesting parent episode, if any (ADR-0051 §3 item 3: non-canonical, nested, goal-relative grain).

segmentation.description: Segmentation lifecycle state. proposed = opt-out capture proposal (no authority); accepted = standing reached by silent acceptance; re-cut = human-corrected boundary (ERE-07).

derived_from.description: Source ids this episode was fused/derived from -- Heimdal per-session episode_ids and/or other stream boundary hints. Never a fused ep-<uuid> equal to this note's own episode_id.
